Hi Sarah / Jordan —

Thanks again for the productive renewal call yesterday. Per our discussion I’m sending over the proposed Renewal SOW (Renewal_SOW_v3.docx) and an internal reconciliation of Exhibit E usage tiers. Two quick asks to keep us moving:

- Can you confirm whether EdgeWare wants to keep the 24-month term or move to 12 months with a planned uplift in Q2 next year?
- Jordan / legal: you mentioned a few redlines on retention and audit scope — if you can share those as a marked-up PDF we’ll triage and return a consolidated counter.

We also want to be explicit about the additional capacity increase (+40% token throughput) you requested; I included a draft clause in the SOW but we’d prefer to capture the exact usage tiers in Exhibit E rather than in the MSA body.

Attachments: Renewal_SOW_v3.docx, RW_ExhibitE_Recon_v2.pdf

Next steps: if you can get redlines back by EOD Wednesday (9/9) we’ll assemble legal + pricing and aim for a clean MSA + order form for signature the following week.

Cheers,

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-08T12:58:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: EdgeWare counter (Exhibit E) — quick internal triage

Ben / Marissa — forwarding EdgeWare's counter. Key asks we need to decide on asap:

1) Term: they want 12 months. We lose 1 year of committed ARR predictability if we concede. If we insist on 24 months, pricing needs to be rebalanced (they're asking for a 40% capacity bump).

2) Service credit holdback for first 30 days — ops can we accept limited credits during initial uplift? Ben, you did a similar onboarding for Novus last quarter.

3) Indemnity carve-outs — legal will push back on licensing carve-outs for model suppliers; this is a stick point but we can offer a mutual indemnity cap tied to annual spend.

4) Exhibit E tiers — the customer changed rounding on token bands which affects per-token unit economics. I attached our reconciliation (RW_ExhibitE_Recon_v2.pdf) to show impact.

Suggested playbook: counter 12-mo term but offer 15 months with a 6% discount to bridge; accept a limited service credit holdback (cap = $25k) for onboarding; keep indemnity language but offer carve-out clarifications.

Can you both weigh in quickly? I told them we'd come back within 24 hours.

Thanks —
Rachel

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-08T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: EdgeWare counter (Exhibit E) — quick internal triage

Short answers:

- Onboarding credits: we can accept a 30-day ramp credit with a $25k cap. That's consistent with recent deals.
- Term: push back to 18 months as a middle ground. 15 months is fine if pricing moves 4.5% in our favor vs their 12-mo.
- Indemnity: legal will hate the license carve-out. Offer a mutual cap at 1x ARR and exclude wilful misconduct.

Pricing note: the +40% capacity bump adds ~$58k ARR at current rates; moving to 15 months vs 12 months net present value favors us materially. I'll assemble two options (12-mo discount vs 15-mo small uplift) and share in an hour.

-Ben
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@edgeware.ai>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@edgeware.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, EdgeWare Legal <legal@edgeware.ai>
Date: 2027-09-09T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: term alignment and Exhibit E reconciliation

Jordan / Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround and for surfacing the redlines. We ran this with internal pricing and legal; below is our starting counter so we can converge quickly: 

- Term: Redwood prefers 18 months. If EdgeWare requires 12 months we can accommodate but at a 6% uplift on the per-token rate (applies to the capacity increase). Alternatively, we will accept 15 months at a 3% uplift (preferred path).
- Service credit holdback: we will accept a 30-day onboarding credit with a firm cap of $25,000.
- Indemnity: we will not accept an indemnity carve-out for third-party model licensors. Proposed compromise: mutual indemnity with a 1x ARR cap, and explicit carve-outs for wilful misconduct and gross negligence.
- Exhibit E: attached is our reconciled Exhibit E and a redline summary (RW_ExhibitE_Recon_v2.pdf). We kept the capacity tiers you requested but adjusted breakpoints to preserve unit economics.

I've attached a clean MSA with those items marked for clarity and an updated Exhibit E (RW_ExhibitE_Recon_v2.pdf). If these are acceptable we can issue a DocuSign clean copy for signature (https://www.docusign.com/edgeware/renewal/DW-4931).

We'd like to lock this by end of next week to align onboarding and capacity provisioning. Please let me know any non-starters and we'll route to legal.

Best,
Rachel
